cigarsmoking_meadow_seeds_desc: Seeds of the meadow tobacco plant. Sow them in cultivated soil with the cultivator.
cigarsmoking_meadow_leaf_desc: A big green meadow leaf, fresh from the plant and bitter. Hang it on a drying rack.
cigarsmoking_meadow_dried_desc: A meadow leaf dried on the rack until it is golden and brittle. Pack it in a curing barrel to age it, or roll it as it is.
cigarsmoking_meadow_aged_desc: A meadow leaf cured in the barrel until it is dark, oily and smooth. The wrapper and filler of a fine cigar.
cigarsmoking_meadow_plant_desc: Sow meadow tobacco seeds in cultivated soil. It grows tall in a few days and gives leaves and seeds.
cigarsmoking_forest_seeds_desc: Seeds of the forest tobacco plant. Sow them in cultivated soil with the cultivator.
cigarsmoking_forest_leaf_desc: A big green forest leaf, fresh from the plant and bitter. Hang it on a drying rack.
cigarsmoking_forest_dried_desc: A forest leaf dried on the rack until it is golden and brittle. Pack it in a curing barrel to age it, or roll it as it is.
cigarsmoking_forest_aged_desc: A forest leaf cured in the barrel until it is dark, oily and smooth. The wrapper and filler of a fine cigar.
cigarsmoking_forest_plant_desc: Sow forest tobacco seeds in cultivated soil. It grows tall in a few days and gives leaves and seeds.
cigarsmoking_plains_seeds_desc: Seeds of the plains tobacco plant. Sow them in cultivated soil with the cultivator.
cigarsmoking_plains_leaf_desc: A big green plains leaf, fresh from the plant and bitter. Hang it on a drying rack.
cigarsmoking_plains_dried_desc: A plains leaf dried on the rack until it is golden and brittle. Pack it in a curing barrel to age it, or roll it as it is.
cigarsmoking_plains_aged_desc: A plains leaf cured in the barrel until it is dark, oily and smooth. The wrapper and filler of a fine cigar.
cigarsmoking_plains_plant_desc: Sow plains tobacco seeds in cultivated soil. It grows tall in a few days and gives leaves and seeds.
cigarsmoking_connecticut_desc: Light and golden, rolled from shade-grown meadow leaf. Mild and mellow: a cigar for taking it easy.
cigarsmoking_connecticut_start: You light a Connecticut and take it easy.
cigarsmoking_maduro_desc: The darkest and slowest to make. Long ageing and a touch of honey leave it sweet and smooth, and it mends the body a little faster.
cigarsmoking_maduro_start: You light a Maduro. Smooth and sweet.
cigarsmoking_habano_desc: Oily and spicy, rolled from plains leaf with a cloudberry bite. It gets the blood going: swings and sprints cost less breath.
cigarsmoking_habano_start: You light a Habano. Your blood runs hot.
cigarsmoking_corojo_desc: Reddish and peppery, rolled from black forest leaf with thistle in the filler. The smoke hangs about you and you move quietly in it.
cigarsmoking_corojo_start: You light a Corojo and slip into the shadows.
cigarsmoking_table_desc: Roll cigars from cured leaf. Build a Humidor beside it for the finer cigars.
cigarsmoking_humidor_desc: A cedar cabinet that keeps leaf and cigars at their best. Build it near a Cigar Rolling Table to roll the finer cigars.
cigarsmoking_rack_desc: Hang fresh tobacco leaves here to dry in the air.
cigarsmoking_barrel_desc: Pack dried tobacco leaves in here to age and ferment into dark, oily leaf.
cigarsmoking_bag_full: Your bag is full: the rest is on the ground
cigarsmoking_rack_no_leaves: You have no leaves for the tobacco drying rack
cigarsmoking_barrel_no_leaves: You have no leaves for the tobacco curing barrel
cigarsmoking_rack_in_use: The tobacco drying rack is already in use: your leaves are back
cigarsmoking_barrel_in_use: The tobacco curing barrel is already in use: your leaves are back
